$comment: Ceilings for `yarn validate:anatomy-parts` (TASK-N2-S1, ADR-19). Both ratchet DOWN, never up -- raising one is how a styling contract quietly stops being one, which is the same rule `maxWithoutAnatomy` in ../ownership/unclassified-ceiling.json follows.
$comment.maxUndeclaredEmissions: Static `data-part="x"` sites that no anatomy declares -- neither the emitting component's own, nor a composing parent's, nor (for an unexported internal) every component that renders it. Initialised on 2026-09-02 at the measured value on this tree. The whole population is DzOptionsState.vue: an UNEXPORTED internal, absent from the ownership manifest and from component-meta.json, which emits `options-state`, `options-message` and `options-retry` into DzCascader, DzCombobox, DzListbox, DzMultiSelect, DzSelect, DzTransfer and DzTreeSelect. DzSelect is an ADR-19 PILOT and declares none of the three. It falls to 0 when the forms family slice completes; it cannot be closed component-by-component, because the internal's parts are governed only when EVERY host declares them. CLOSED on 2026-09-04 by the TASK-R5-O2 FORMS packet: the owner took decision D15 / S1-D4 as option (d) and all seven hosts (DzCascader, DzCombobox, DzListbox, DzMultiSelect, DzSelect, DzTransfer, DzTreeSelect) now declare the three parts, plus DzPersonaSelector, which renders a DzCombobox that renders the row. The validator reports 0/3 undeclared. Ratchets DOWN only; there is no reading above zero.
$comment.maxUnemittedDeclarations: A declared, non-optional part that no source emits -- a promise with nothing behind it. Ceiling ZERO from the start: there was exactly one on this tree (DzFileUpload declared `parts: ['root']` and its template emitted no data-part at all), it was fixed in the same change that added this gate, and there is no reading under which a second one is acceptable.
$comment.maxUndeclaredStates: A data-state VALUE a template can produce that no anatomy declares -- neither the emitting component's own nor a composing parent's (TASK-R5-O1, ADR-19 s4). This is the gate that replaced the closed `DataState` union in @dzup-ui/contracts: the union DzButton violated from the day it shipped, which is the argument s4 makes for widening DataAttributes['data-state'] to string and moving the constraint into the per-component enum. A union nothing checks is not a contract. Initialised on 2026-09-04 at the measured value on 99b963a. The whole population is ONE: DzTableRow.vue:99 emits data-state="expanded" on the expansion row, and DzTable -- the parent that owns the compound part -- declares ready|loading|selected. Exit condition: add 'expanded' to DzTable.anatomy.ts states AND regenerate component-ownership.manifest.json in the same change (the manifest carries the states array, so the source edit alone makes validate:ownership stale). TASK-R5-O1 could not regenerate the manifest: a concurrent session held it. Ratchets DOWN only. CLOSED on 2026-09-04 by TASK-R5-O2 (owner decision D11, option (a)): `expanded` is declared in DzTable.anatomy.ts and the manifest was regenerated in the same change, so the ceiling is 0 and there is no reading above it.
$comment.maxStatesWithoutAnatomy: A data-state value emitted by a component that declares no anatomy and has no owner that does, so nothing constrains it. The state-side twin of maxWithoutAnatomy in ../ownership/unclassified-ceiling.json, and it falls the same way: every component the anatomy rollout (TASK-R5-O2) reaches moves its values out of this count and under maxUndeclaredStates. Initialised on 2026-09-04 at the value measured by this validator on 99b963a: 88 values across the components with no anatomy. Ratchets DOWN only -- raising it admits a new ungoverned state, which is the failure the rule exists to prevent. Lowered to 79 on 2026-09-04 by TASK-R5-O2's first five slices: nine values moved under `maxUndeclaredStates` as DzBlockUI, DzCarousel, DzCollapse, DzNotification, DzSpinner and their family members declared the states they were already emitting. Lowered to 50 on 2026-09-04 by the TASK-R5-O2 CONTINUATION packet (navigation 12/12 and data 11/12 Tier B+): 29 more values moved under `maxUndeclaredStates` as DzAccordion, DzCalendar, DzChip, DzDataGrid, DzListItem, DzMenu, DzOrderList, DzPagination, DzSegmented, DzSidebar, DzStepperItem, DzTabs, DzTag, DzTree, DzTreeItem and their family members declared the states they were already emitting. The remainder is dominated by `forms`, which is blocked on S1-D4 / D15. Lowered to 17 on 2026-09-04 by the TASK-R5-O2 FORMS packet: 33 more values moved under `maxUndeclaredStates` as the 24 remaining Tier B+ forms components declared the states they were already emitting. The 17 that remain are emitted by Tier A components, which this task deliberately excludes.
$comment.maxUnreviewedPartNames: A declared part name in NEITHER the ADR-19 shared vocabulary NOR ANATOMY_PART_EXTENSIONS (TASK-R5-O1, resolving N2-S1 S1-D1 / ADR-19 packet D19-11). ADR-19 s3 says the vocabulary grows DELIBERATELY and that the validator lists out-of-vocabulary names so it can; this is the other half -- a name has to be either folded in or recorded as a deliberate extension with a reason. Ceiling ZERO from the start: on 2026-09-04 all 14 shipped out-of-vocabulary names were reviewed, 7 folded into the vocabulary (clear, toggle, filename, language, body, row, cell) and 7 recorded as extensions. Renaming a shipped part name is breaking, which is why the review is cheapest before the name ships and why this ceiling has no reading above zero.
$comment.maxHeldPartNames: An extension recorded with status 'held' -- reviewed only as far as 'not decided yet'. Three today, all on 2026-09-04: options-state, options-message and options-retry, which DzSelect declares and DzOptionsState.vue emits into seven form components. They read like a namespace and were never reviewed; they are blocked on the DzOptionsState disposition (ADR-19 packet D19-10 / N2-S1 S1-D4), which is the same decision maxUndeclaredEmissions: 3 waits on. Ratchets DOWN as each held name gets its decision. CLOSED on 2026-09-04 by the TASK-R5-O2 FORMS packet: with D15 taken as option (d), the three names were promoted from `held` to `reviewed` in ANATOMY_PART_EXTENSIONS with all eight declaring components as owners and the reason for keeping them component-specific written at the entry (`empty`, `error` and `loader` are three vocabulary words for what this row renders as ONE node whose state changes, and the names are shipped, so renaming is breaking). The validator reports 0/3 held.
